Marissa / Laura / Ben — reviewed Andes' redlines and propose the following redline language to balance Marketing's needs and the customer's requests. Below are two short clauses (publicity and reference rights) you can drop into the MSA/order form. I've kept the wording tight so procurement can sign off quickly.

1) Publicity; Press Releases
Neither party shall issue a public press release, joint announcement, or case study referencing the other party in a manner that identifies the other party as a customer without the other party's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed. For clarity, "prior written consent" may be provided by e-mail to the parties' primary contacts. Customer may request an embargo period of up to ninety (90) days following the Effective Date for any public announcement; Redwood may use internal enablement materials during the embargo that are not shared with third parties.

2) Logos and Marks; Reference Use
Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Customer's name and logo solely to identify Customer as a Redwood customer on Redwood's website, in customer lists, and in non-paid marketing materials ("Permitted Uses"). Such use is subject to Customer providing Redwood with approved logo files and reasonable brand guidelines. Logos shall not be used in paid advertising or integrated into product UI without Customer's prior written approval. For case studies or testimonial quotes, Redwood will obtain separate written approval from Customer in each instance.

If Andes insists on an opt-in checkbox on the order form for reference rights, we can include a line in the order form: "Customer elects (yes/no) to grant Redwood reference rights as described above." That preserves Redwood's ability to request permission later while capturing Andes' procurement preference.

Other suggestions: add a 7 business day review turnaround for approval requests in the clause to keep timelines predictable. Also call out that approvals may be provided by email and log timestamps in our approval tracker.

I'll attach a DOCX with tracked changes for the MSA snippet and a cleaned text file for inclusion in the order form.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
